title: 244 foreigners nabbed in anti-scam raid in Zamboanga Sibugay face deportation
summary: The 244 foreign nationals arrested in the alleged scam hubs in Zamboanga Sibugay are temporarily detained and will undergo deportation proceedings, the Bureau of Immigration said on Sunday.
